comments.text:
One of the best parts of this series is its songs and music. Specially this song..the music deserves special mention. It begins simply but touches the deepest parts of the soul. Lyrics is incredibly mesmerizing & soulful. It has been grooving in my mind ever since I first heard it. Huge applause to lyricist Prashant Pandey and singers Goldie Sohel and Vidhi Jaiswal you all deserve immense respect for this outstanding song.

Bollywood rarely makes such heartfelt songs now. They should truly learn from the makers of Aspirants. 👏
